implemented_behavior.fetch: lower 128-bit word then upper 128-bit word for current PC only
implemented_behavior.blocked_policy: hold current decoded command without lookahead
implemented_behavior.issue_policy: issue exactly once after operands, banks, and selected executor are ready
implemented_behavior.reservation_policy: bank reservation commits on executor request valid-and-ready
implemented_behavior.completion_policy: PC advances only after matching successful response handshake
implemented_behavior.failure_policy: unknown opcode, illegal operand, executor error, or tag mismatch terminates without destination-ready commit
implemented_behavior.queue_policy: no ring queue and no producer/consumer index

latency.initiation_interval: one complete command including its response; maximum one outstanding

coverage: normal DMA_LOAD DMA_LOAD GEMM DMA_STORE strict order
no next BRAM fetch while a command is outstanding
zero and oversized command count rejection
unknown opcode and illegal bank rejection
executor error destination fault and later-command suppression
reset during fetch, issue, and wait-completion
simulation.launcher_note: The ordinary xsim launcher raised an environment-specific internal Tcl exception after successful compile/elaboration; the generated same-source snapshot xsimk was executed directly and produced the checked PASS marker. The launcher failure log is preserved.

vivado.ooc_external_hold_policy: Only unplaced external-port ingress/egress hold paths are excluded; DUT register-to-register setup and hold paths remain timed.

does_not_claim: AXI BRAM Controller or PS register wrapper
board integration, bitstream, or physical-board validation
